hits.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
hits.abstract_snippet: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. hits.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
hits.abstract_snippet: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage.
